Generated by file/binutils in a Landlock/seccomp sandbox; target never executed.
Binary SHA-256: `c90c1f272ce9a72bffd3234cccab2f5b61ae861ed16e5778cacb80ac9ab9ca6a`.

```text
ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64, version 1 (SYSV), dynamically linked, interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, BuildID[sha1]=93fc95aa7028f0fdc5fa8efe11c04ae24b2b0f53, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, stripped
```

Source correspondence findings:

Upstream build.sh explicitly maps langdetect_gcc_stripped.c to this dynamic output using gcc, then strip --strip-all --remove-section=.comment. No .symtab or .debug_info remains. Main body is ELF VA 0x1149 (Ghidra 0x101149); loop calls atoi at 0x1182, compares i against argc at 0x1191, and calls printf at 0x11aa. Literal at ELF VA 0x2004 agrees.

Compiler markers are object-level hints, not proof of complete build flags:

No retained GCC marker; see ground truth for available build metadata.
